rules.statement: A person who, with knowledge of the vendor's intended fraud, joins the wrongdoer in a transaction for their mutual benefit is guilty of 'collusion' which can defeat the priority conferred by law under Section 7(2) of the Registration of Documents Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: In other words, he entered into a collusive transaction with Thambimuttu and lent himself as a party to the latter's intended fraud on his previous vendors. This thoroughly disreputable transaction took place within a short time of the date on which the appellants' rights under 1D2 would have been strengthened by the acquisition of prescriptive title to the 1/4 share purchased by them in 1938.
